name: Participant Report
summary: Generates a participant-friendly HTML report with interactive viewers for a T1w image, FreeSurfer surfaces and parcellation, white matter tracts and BOLD thumbnails.
description: Builds an HTML page section by section for whichever inputs are given: a Papaya viewer of the T1w, FreeSurfer T1, aparc+aseg and pial surfaces, a tract viewer for the wmc tracts and surfaces, and thumbnails of the BOLD series. Use it to share an easy-to-read summary of a participant's data. All inputs are optional; the FreeSurfer section needs a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer output; T1, aparc+aseg and pial surfaces are shown in the report.
White matter classification with tract and surface files, shown in an interactive tract viewer.
fMRI time series; thumbnails are generated for the report.
T1-weighted image shown in an interactive volume viewer.

outputs.description: HTML report (index.html) with embedded viewers and images.

failure_modes.fix: Set FREESURFER_LICENSE on the resource when a FreeSurfer input is given.
